speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing fatigue, unintentional weight loss, and have had some abnormal physical examination findings. To begin our assessment, have you noticed any night sweats or fevers accompanying these symptoms?

speaker: Doctor
text: That is concerning; a 5 kg weight loss in 6 months without increased appetite is significant. Has this been accompanied by cough, hemoptysis, or persistent lymph node swelling? Also, have you noticed any night sweats or fevers?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue. I also have 5 kg unintentional weight loss over 6 months, Good appetite.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That is a classic presentation of "B symptoms" associated with lymphomas. Has this fatigue been accompanied by pruritus (itching), easy bruising, or any changes in your skin or gums?
